name: DUMBBELL TRICEPS EXTENSION
introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. 

Use your hands to grab a dumbbell by interlocking your thumbs, and raise the dumbbell overhead. 

Bring the dumbbell back down, and then raise it up. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please squeeze your triceps when raising the dumbbell up.
Please tighten your core and stabilize your back.
Please keep your elbows facing forward.
It’s a great exercise for your triceps.
